s1.syndrome_frame: Progressive heart failure with possible valve dysfunction and systemic inflammation
salient_findings: Progressive dyspnea on exertion, orthopnea, and paroxysmal nocturnal dyspnea
Elevated erythrocyte sedimentation rate and positive C-reactive protein
key_facts: 36-year-old woman with rheumatic mitral stenosis
Status post mitral valvotomy and two valve repairs
Received streptokinase for suspected prosthetic mitral valve thrombosis two weeks earlier
Symptoms of dyspnea on exertion, orthopnea, and paroxysmal nocturnal dyspnea for 4 days
Fever and bilateral knee pain for 3 days
No pallor, icterus, cyanosis, edema, or jugular venous distension on examination
Hemoglobin 9.65 g/dL
Neutrophils 41%, lymphocytes 43%, platelets 4,456,000/µL
Prothrombin time 32.8 s, INR 2.5
Elevated erythrocyte sedimentation rate and positive C-reactive protein
Blood and urine cultures were sterile
Serologic tests for hepatitis B surface antigen, antinuclear antibody, anti–cyclic citrullinated peptide antibody, and lactate dehydrogenase were negative

shortlist.label: Prosthetic Valve Endocarditis
shortlist.why_kept: Recent history of suspected prosthetic mitral valve thrombosis and receipt of streptokinase, along with symptoms of dyspnea and systemic inflammation

shortlist.label: Infective Endocarditis
shortlist.why_kept: Clinical presentation of fever, dyspnea, and elevated inflammatory markers, which are consistent with infective endocarditis

shortlist.label: Mitral Valve Regurgitation
shortlist.why_kept: History of rheumatic mitral stenosis and mitral valvotomy, which increases the risk of mitral regurgitation

shortlist.label: Rheumatic Heart Disease
shortlist.why_kept: Patient's history of rheumatic mitral stenosis and previous valve repairs, which suggests ongoing rheumatic heart disease

shortlist.label: Nonbacterial Thrombotic Endocarditis
shortlist.why_kept: Recent history of thrombosis and receipt of streptokinase, along with the presence of systemic inflammation
